title: Print Window Tertiary Color
description: Fix print window heading hierarchy to use semio-tertiary color for subsubsection level before transitioning to colorless (muted) paragraph windows. Currently jumps from secondary directly to chrome border color.
summary: Fixed print window heading color hierarchy: subsubsection now uses semio-tertiary (orange) instead of semio-chrome-border-normal, restoring the intended primary → secondary → tertiary → colorless (paragraph) progression.
